item.title: 21 Aug — Asia locks fixtures; Europe kicks off
item.description:
What changed for us
- Asia — AFC Challenge League draw is done (Aug 20): The Asian Football Confederation completed the 2026/27 Challenge League group-stage draw in Kuala Lumpur, setting the full slate and timings. Why it matters (inference): this locks Asia prime‑time fixtures through autumn, a clean runway to list pre‑match and in‑play books that hand off into UAE/MENA evenings. Source: AFC. (…
